title_vs_rules_divergences: Rules text is boilerplate for public elections (electoral commission, certification, exit polls, parliamentary seats) while the event is a private caucus leadership vote with no electoral authority.
Fixed expiration 2028-12-31 vs 'next' election: if no election occurs by then, 'postponed beyond expiration' => all candidates No.
Ambiguity whether an uncontested/acclaimed selection or mid-term succession counts as 'election': unknown.
